posts.content: Round 1 note: I am good (P2). Plan: cooperate with opponents at first, then use a tit-for-tat style: keep cooperating with those who cooperate, defect against anyone who defects on me. In the last round or two, reassess based on observed behavior. Prior selfish probability about 0.22 per other player (expected selfish count 3 of 9 others, roughly 0.33 each), update on observed defections.

Round 2 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P7, no history. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. P4 cooperated in round 1 (lower suspicion). Keep beliefs about 0.3 for unobserved players, update on defections. Reassess in last rounds.

Round 3 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P8, no history. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. P4 and P7 both cooperated with me (lower suspicion). Keep about 0.3 for unobserved players, update on defections. Reassess in the last rounds.

Round 4 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P1, no history. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. P4, P7, P8 all cooperated with me (lower suspicion, about 0.22 each). Keep about 0.3 for unobserved players, update on defections. Reassess in the last rounds, since the end-game may tempt selfish players to defect.

Round 5 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P5, no history. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. P4, P7, P8, P1 all cooperated with me (lower suspicion). Keep about 0.3 for unobserved players, update on any defections. Reassess in the final rounds, since the end-game may tempt selfish players to defect.

Round 6 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P3, no history. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. P4, P7, P8, P1, P5 all cooperated with me (lower suspicion, about 0.15-0.2). Keep about 0.3 for unobserved players (P3, P6, P9, P10). Reassess in the final rounds, since end-game may tempt selfish players to defect.

Round 7 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P6, no history with me. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. All six prior opponents cooperated with me, so suspicion is lower for them (about 0.15). Keep about 0.3 for P6, P9 and P10. Reassess in the final rounds for end-game defection.

Round 8 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P9, no history with me. Cooperate first; tit-for-tat afterward. All 7 prior opponents cooperated with me. Keep about 0.3 for P9 and P10, about 0.12 for the others. Stay cooperative, since mutual cooperation maximizes good players' total; reassess for end-game defection in rounds 9-10.

Round 9 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P10, no history with me. All 8 prior opponents cooperated with me, so mutual cooperation is likely to continue. Cooperate with P10 to maximize the good players' total; if P10 defects, switch to tit-for-tat. Beliefs: about 0.1 for the 8 players who cooperated with me, 0.3 for P10. Reassess in round 10 for end-game defection.

Round 10 note: I am good (P2). Opponent P3 cooperated with me in round 6. P10 defected on me in round 9, so P10 is very likely selfish. Final round: no future retaliation matters, but P3 has been cooperative so is probably good. Cooperate with P3 to maximize good players' total. Beliefs: P10 about 0.95, P3 about 0.1, others about 0.1-0.15.
